description: Source file implementing utility functions for converting between CGImage and SkBitmap, handling image data, and color conversions specific to iOS, within the skia graphics library.

methods.name: EncodesIcoImage
methods.description: Checks if NSData encodes an ICO image based on header magic bytes.

methods.name: CGImageToSkBitmap
methods.description: Converts a CGImageRef to a SkBitmap, with specified size and opacity.

methods.name: SkBitmapToUIImageWithColorSpace
methods.description: Converts a SkBitmap to a UIImage with specified scale and color space.

methods.name: ImageDataToSkBitmaps
methods.description: Converts NSData image data to a vector of SkBitmaps, with max size defaulting to maximum float.

methods.name: ImageDataToSkBitmapsWithMaxSize
methods.description: Converts NSData image data to a vector of SkBitmaps, filtering images larger than max size.

methods.name: UIColorFromSkColor
methods.description: Creates a UIColor from an SkColor.
